scenes.title: The Euphoria & The Hidden Wire
scenes.text: It was supposed to be easy money. In early 2026, millions of everyday people across China—teachers, cab drivers, students—watched their trading apps light up green on the morning commute. The rally felt unstoppable. But behind the hype lay a quiet time bomb: almost everyone was buying on borrowed money.

scenes.title: The Trap Snaps
scenes.text: Then, the market blinked. Just an ordinary two-percent dip. But when you trade with triple leverage, a tiny tremor isn't a dip—it's an execution order. Before traders could even unlock their screens, brokerage algorithms took control, dumping collateral into freefall.

scenes.title: The Human Stampede
scenes.text: On Wall Street, big banks absorb the shock. But ninety percent of China's market is retail. It's a crowded theater with only one exit door. When automated margin calls hit thirty million phones at the exact same second, panic went viral. Everyone smashed sell—into an empty room.

scenes.title: The Broken Spell
scenes.text: Beijing threw hundreds of billions into the fire. State funds bought index funds. Regulators banned short selling. But when a bubble built on borrowed faith bursts, you can't print confidence. Two trillion dollars didn't just vanish—the illusion broke.
